description: Per-model token usage and cost, highest token count first. Use this to answer "which model consumed the most tokens". Cost is labelled reported vs estimated per model.

client.description: Restrict to any of these clients. A single client id is also accepted.

days.description: Look back this many days, counted from local midnight. Omit for all time.

includeSubagents.description: Include subagent/sidechain turns. Defaults to true, because they are real spend. Set false to see only main-thread turns.

models.description: Restrict to any of these model ids, exactly as the client recorded them. Use model_usage to see the ids present.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use the `nextOffset` from the previous result.

projectPath.description: Deprecated spelling of projectPaths, for one project. Still honoured.

projectPaths.description: Restrict to any of these projects, given as the absolute working directories the turns ran in. Each must match exactly; use project_usage to see the available paths. A value matching no record anywhere is reported as such rather than returning an empty period.

sort.description: Row ordering, descending. There is deliberately no plain "cost": reported and estimated cost are separate figures that are never summed, so ordering by one sorts every row priced on the other basis as though it were $0. Pick the basis you mean; the result reports how many rows that ordering could not speak for.

today.description: Restrict to today, in local time.

name: model_usage
title: Usage by model
